question: B-03: Chat synchronization. Why this fork must be decided: the user wants online contact with human staff but has not required millisecond real time; the existing system uses Next/PostgreSQL and no new broker is to be added.

options.A: Incremental short polling: every 3 seconds while the chat/inbox is open; pause while hidden; back off to 30 seconds; use a seq cursor to fill gaps. This has at most several seconds of delay and additional queries.
options.B: SSE push plus the same cursor-based gap filling. This has low latency but requires verification of proxy buffering, long connections, and reconnection capacity. Next instances cannot rely on in-memory broadcasting.
